nodes.label: Skill: drawio (native .drawio diagram generation & export)
nodes.rationale: Generic diagram engine invoked by other skills; XML is generated directly because Mermaid/CSV need server-side conversion.

nodes.label: Tool: draw.io (activity diagram; added to the tools table at section 11)
draw.io: native mxGraphModel XML with root cells id=0 and id=1
nodes.rationale: Always generate XML directly - Mermaid and CSV need server-side conversion and cannot be saved as native files. Missing root cells render a blank diagram; a self-closing edge cell renders no edge.

nodes.label: Critical: never emit XML comments; escape special chars; unique cell ids
nodes.rationale: Comments waste tokens and can cause parse errors that produce an empty or corrupt export.

nodes.label: draw.io: export png/svg/pdf with --embed-diagram, then delete the .drawio source
nodes.rationale: The exported file carries the full diagram XML so it stays editable in draw.io; if the CLI is missing, keep the .drawio file and point at app.diagrams.net.
